subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **dependent.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dependent means needing the support of something or someone in order to continue existing or operating.

 
 
• **Example -** *An economy is heavily **dependent **on oil exports.*
 
 
 
• ​Here in the given paragraph, **'dependent'** is used to describe that **Pythons need water to survive, without water they cannot live in harmony. So, Pythons are dependent on water to live a sustainable life.**
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is** 'dependent'.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 

**Correct Paragraph:**__ *Python snake, also known as Ajgar, is one of the most (1) __massively__ built snakes of the Indian subcontinent. It belongs to the Boidae family and is **(2)** **__dependent__** on water to quite an extent. One of the (3)__________ features of the Rock pythons of India is that they can raise their body temperature above the ambient level (4) ________ muscular contractions. Rock python is a (5) ___________ creature, moving only while hunting or when threatened.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Correspondent** means one who communicates with another by letter.
 
• **Intermittent** means a periodic movement, stopping and starting over a period of time.
 
• **Inconsistent** means lacking in harmony between the different parts or elements; self-contradictory.
